response.content:
## AI Companies Entering the Finnish Market in 2026

The Finnish AI landscape has been active in 2026, with several notable market entries and expansions:

### Major Infrastructure Investments

- **Nebius Group** — The AI cloud infrastructure provider announced a major expansion in Finland, developing a second facility in Mäntsälä and a new site in Lappeenranta. Nebius outlined a $40–45 billion capital expenditure roadmap for 2027, with Finnish data centres forming a key part of its global GPU cluster expansion.

- **Google** — After temporarily suspending a multi-trillion-won data centre expansion plan in Finland (following the government's abolition of electricity tax reductions), Google resumed the project in September 2026, citing Finland's stable power supply as advantageous.

### AI Startups and Funding Activity

According to Tracxn data, **14 new AI startups were founded in Finland so far in 2026**, continuing a strong trend (21 were founded in 2025, the highest in the past decade). Notable funding rounds in 2026 include:

- **Verda** — Raised a Series A (April 2026) and Series B (September 2026, led by Emergence Capital) to expand GPU capacity in Finnish data centres, benefiting from renewable power.
- **SeeTrue Technologies** — Raised a Seed round (August 2026) with ZEISS among the investors.
- **Rotomate** — Raised a Seed round (June 2026) with Kvanted among the investors.
- **Retailgrid** — Raised a Seed round (May 2026).
- **Userlens** — Raised a Seed round (April 2026) backed by Y Combinator.

### Partnerships and Ecosystem Developments

- **Vivicta** partnered with Finnish AI platform company **ConfidentialMind** (founded in 2023 at Aalto University) to accelerate sovereign AI adoption across the Nordics, targeting highly regulated and security-sensitive use cases.

- **Advian**, a Finnish data and AI company, was accepted into the **NVIDIA Inception** startup programme to accelerate its growth in Physical AI, industrial intelligence, and smart energy systems.

- The **LUMI AI Factory** (based in Finland, home to the LUMI supercomputer) launched an incubation programme for early-stage AI startups from across Europe, with a Demo Day planned in Espoo.

- **ELLIS Institute Finland** was officially launched in 2026, recruiting seven new principal investigators and establishing itself as a major AI research hub.

### Broader Context

Business Finland and AI Finland published the "AI in Finnish Business 2026" report in April 2026, highlighting widespread AI adoption across Finnish companies. The IMF noted in November 2026 that Finland's growth broadened in 2026, supported by stronger exports, and recommended attracting skilled talent from abroad to strengthen Finland's AI ecosystem.

To mitigate the counterparty and operational risks inherent in third-party development, Nebius is shifting future capacity additions toward owned-and-operated sites. The company’s expansion roadmap focuses on scaling proprietary sites, including a second facility in Mäntsälä and new development in Lappeenranta, Finland, alongside domestic US campus developments in Missouri and Alabama. As facilities expand to multi-hundred-megawatt scales, the environmental footprint and power grid interactions become critical operational factors, directly impacting institutional evaluations of compute carbon footprint when accounting for large-scale training workloads.

## Implications for University Research Computing and Procurement [...] AI cloud infrastructure provider Nebius Group announced on November 12, 2026, an ambitious capital expenditure roadmap projecting between $40 billion and $45 billion in planned infrastructure spending for 2027 to aggressively expand its global graphics processing unit (GPU) clusters and data centre operations. The planned investment follows a revision of its full-year 2026 capital expenditure target to approximately $27 billion, reflecting accelerating industrial demand for specialized artificial intelligence model training and inference capacity. Nebius aims to surpass one gigawatt of operational power capacity across its facilities to serve hyperscale clients and enterprise foundation model developers.

Vivicta is a trusted Nordic transformation partner making everyday easier through technology. In a world of constant change, we are with our customers, helping unlock new digital opportunities and elevate their business. We provide fit-for-purpose digital solutions to accelerate customers’ transformation. Our 7000+ experts globally drive end-to-end excellence across Data, Automation & AI, Cloud & Infrastructure, ERP & Applications, and Digital Security. With a get-it-done attitude, we commit to deliver elevated impact.

ConfidentialMind is a Finland-based AI software company enabling sovereign AI deployments across any environment. Founded in 2023 at the Aalto University campus, backed by leading European venture capital investors. www.confidentialmind.com

### Want to know more? [...] Vivicta has entered into a partnership with Finnish AI platform company ConfidentialMind to accelerate the adoption of sovereign AI across the Nordics. By combining ConfidentialMind’s AI operations platform with Vivicta’s expertise in sovereign AI, cloud, infrastructure and managed services, the partnership will help organizations deploy and operate AI in secure and trusted environments. The offering is designed especially for highly regulated and security-sensitive AI use cases, while improving scalability and cost efficiency. [...] A key objective of the partnership is to make sovereign AI more accessible and commercially viable for Nordic organizations. Rather than requiring every organization to build and operate dedicated AI environments, Vivicta is investing in shared sovereign AI capabilities that can be utilized by multiple customers. This approach lowers both the cost and complexity of adoption while maintaining the governance, security and operational control required by enterprise and public sector organizations.

document.name: Vivicta expands sovereign AI capabilities with ConfidentialMind
